purpose: Review generated broad visual concepts before allowing 109 production jobs to render at scale.
retainedDirections: Soft large-shape 2D hand-painted rendering with light volume
Warm dark-brown outlines instead of pure black
Before/After building upgrade reads clearly at a glance
Rounded mobile UI hierarchy with strong foreground/background separation

rejectionReasons.finding: Concept boards introduced Match-3 style grids instead of the required 9x7 Merge-2 board.
Goose guide/guest canon was replaced or diluted by extra human characters, cats or dogs.
Generated signs, labels, slogans, UI copy and pseudo asset IDs were baked into imagery.
Non-target foods, cookware, pets and storefronts appeared without corresponding AssetId/Job.
Some panels became anime/key-art heavy rather than compact casual-game production assets readable at small size.
Broad concept boards are opaque composites and do not validate transparent production exports.
Producer/Cookware/UI state families were not demonstrated consistently.

hardRulesForNextIteration: Board visuals must explicitly be 9 columns x 7 rows and Merge-2; never Match-3, never swap/cascade language.
Character sheets may only contain the requested CharacterId; do not add unrelated people, cats, dogs or mascots.
Goose characters must remain geese and follow character_canon_v4 fixed props/colors/proportions.
Do not render readable Chinese/English text, logos, slogans, store names, fake labels or fake AssetIds inside production imagery.
Do not introduce foods/props/buildings absent from the specific Job target.
Runtime icon jobs must output isolated transparent-background assets, not posters or collages.
UI jobs may use blank glyph placeholders only; actual copy is rendered by Cocos text components.
Building jobs must preserve identical camera, footprint and pivot across Before/After.
Style anchor review is not equivalent to APPROVED runtime art.

requiredPasses: ANCHOR_ITEM_01 is isolated transparent food icon family and remains readable at 64px
ANCHOR_CHAR_02 shows only guide goose Tuantuan with fixed scarf/key tag
ANCHOR_UI_01 contains no baked readable copy or branding
